question_or_proposition: For each evaluation period within Federal FY2025, do the TDS net increase effluent limits annotated with footnote *10 (27,664 lbs/day and 497 mg/L) govern applicability because that period falls on or after the permit effective date and within three years from the permit effective date, rather than the footnote *11 limits (24,992 lbs/day and 449 mg/L) or a period with no applicable numeric limit?
required_context: evaluation period dates within Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30)
footnote *11 temporal applicability boundary relative to footnote *10
notes: Footnote *10 defines when the first-phase TDS net increase numeric limits are in effect. Resolving the temporal window relative to FY2025 evaluation periods determines which enforceable limits apply for compliance comparison under Purpose A.
